paite: Mihat omkhawmte lak ah Pathian adingh a; pathiante lak ah vai ahawm hi.
heading: Asaph phatna La / Pathian, Vaihawmpa Tungnungpen

paite: Bang tan ahia dikloutak a vai na hawm ua, migilou-saloute, na deihsak tuam ding uh?
Gentheite leh pa neiloute hawmsak unla; haksa thuakte, tagahte tung ah hihdik un.
Gentheite leh tagahte gum unla; migilou-salou khut a kipan humbit un.
Athei kei ua, theihsiamna leng anei kei uh; mial ah akileh akileh ua; leilung kingakna tengteng alingta hi;
pathiante na hi ua, na vek un Tungnungpen tate na hi uh, ka chi hi.
Himahleh mihingte bang phet in na hong si ding ua, milian khat bang in na hong puk ding uhi.
Pathian aw, thou inla, lei vai hawmsak in, nam chih na gouluah ding ahi uhi.
